acceptedHighFindings.rationale: Debian trixie remains vulnerable in an SQLite FTS5 MATCH path that requires a crafted SQLite database. Academy production uses PostgreSQL and neither ingests attacker-provided SQLite databases nor executes application FTS5 queries.

Debian trixie remains vulnerable in an SQLite FTS5 MATCH path that requires a crafted SQLite database. Academy production uses PostgreSQL and neither ingests attacker-provided SQLite databases nor executes application FTS5 queries.

The affected glibc ungetwc path requires an exotic overlapping character encoding and does not affect standard Unicode encodings. Academy Python entrypoints use standard Unicode and do not expose native wide-character pushback to product input.
